episodes.synopsis: Torii Yōzō, the South Edo Magistrate, promises to recognize the legitimacy of the Bansha Aratamesho if Ogasawara and the others can recruit a man called Ryūdō Yukiatsu into the organization.
episodes.title: The Youi Arrival

episodes.synopsis: Yukiatsu helps the other Ayashi to protect Ōta from the Yōi.
episodes.title: The God of the Mountain Falls

episodes.synopsis: The samurai residential quarters of Edo are under attack by the second Yōi. Meanwhile, Yuki must choose between a life with Ōta and Tae-san or a life as an ayashi.
episodes.title: Doctrine 3 - Dark Flow of Flowery Edo

episodes.synopsis: The Office of Barbarian Knowledge Enforcement is investigating a series of missing persons around the circus area in Yotsuya. The South Edo Magistrate are also pursuing the same case.
episodes.title: The Living Doll

episodes.synopsis: Tamahei, the Okappiki, suspects that Yukiatsu might have murdered someone in Edo 15 years ago.
episodes.title: Murderer`s Story

episodes.synopsis: The serpent Yōi runs wild in Edo. Torii plans to use Atl as human sacrifice to appease the Yōi.
episodes.title: Dragon Aura Running

episodes.synopsis: Yukiatsu tries to draw out the Ayagami from the serpent Yōi, but finds he is unable to do it. The only thing to do is to try to take the Ayagami from Shichi in order to subdue the Yōi. To change the serpent Yōi into a good spirit, Kumoshichi fuses himself with it.
episodes.title: The Dragon in the Cloud

episodes.synopsis: The Office of Barbarian Knowledge Enforcement is given jurisdiction to investigate the case of missing people around the Kabuki playhouses. Saizō is adamant to investigate the case without Yukiatsu's help.
episodes.title: Fox Play

episodes.synopsis: Saizō is possessed by the Mask Yōi and her dance is drawing all Yōi into Edo. Ogasawara orders his Ayashi to terminate Saizō.
episodes.title: Front and Back

episodes.synopsis: After Ryūdō confronts Saizō and saves her from the Mask Yōi, Saizō manages to destroy the Yōi herself.
episodes.title: Holy Music of Girl Smelling March Flowers

episodes.synopsis: Ryūdō and Ogasawara travel along a highway outside Edo, slaying Yōi to make a safe path for an important official to travel through the area.
episodes.title: Nikkou Spirit Highway

episodes.synopsis: The Western Ones use the Killing Stone to summon a vast number of Yōi in the Nikkō region. Meanwhile, Ogasawara is told he must kill his old friend Kanō to prove his innocence.
episodes.title: Equine Dragon, Howling at the Moon

episodes.synopsis: Tamahei, the policeman, explains to Kai Shūzaburō, a young painter, about the Bansha Aratemesho. His story recaps all the previous episodes.
episodes.title: Record of Rumors of Hell and Paradise

episodes.synopsis: After a woman is murdered in the brothel district, Shūzaburō and Atl come under suspicion from a special branch of the police called the Arson/Thievery Investigations.
episodes.title: Butterfly Dance

episodes.synopsis: The Arson/Thievery Investigations continue to investigate the murders. Eventually the Office of Barbarian Knowledge Enforcement discover that the killer is a Yōi which uses human bodies as a chrysalis.
episodes.title: Woman on the Rashoumon Riverbank

episodes.synopsis: The government officials supporting the Office of Barbarian Knowledge Enforcement come under attack by an elusive gunman, and the ayashi investigate. Meanwhile, Abi meets a tribesman from his past.
episodes.title: The Machine Tribe

episodes.synopsis: Saizō and Edo Gen are help captive by the mountain tribesmen, who reveal that their true target is Torii Yozo. Meanwhile, the other ayashi investigate the tribesmen and Abi searches for his sister.
episodes.title: Cloistered World

episodes.synopsis: The attack on Torii fails. Abi continues to seek his sister, but eventually learns that she resides in the Other World and has become a demon.
episodes.title: Wanderer`s Paradise

episodes.synopsis: Two people, a boy and an aging man, appear in Edo, both claiming to be called Ryūdo Yukiatsu. The ayashi investigate this and in doing so discover more about Ryūdo's past.
episodes.title: Three Yukiatsus

episodes.synopsis: Yukiatsu must decide whether he wants to return to his family permanently. The Ryūdo family sword transforms into a giant yōi and Ryūdo fuses with Kumoshichi to defeat it.
episodes.title: Shinobazu Pond Lullaby

episodes.synopsis: The Western Ones create a new Yōi which travels to Edo and attacks a series of young girls, transforming them into heartless killers. Atl and Saizō act as bait for the Yōi but in the end it chases Edo Gen instead, and is later killed by Ryūdo.
episodes.title: To End on a Starry Night

episodes.synopsis: The ayashi hunt down a sake-based Yōi which dwells in the water systems. Meanwhile, Atl meets a samurai who will soon be forced to commit seppuku so she tries to open a gate to the Other World which will lead him to safety.
episodes.title: A Drunk Who Doesn`t Come Home

episodes.synopsis: The Ayashi receive a plea for help at the Inba Marsh construction site, but Atobe orders Ogasawara to not take action because Torii is supervising the construction and his failure could provoke his downfall. However, Ogasawara does not stop the other Ayashi from going there instead.
episodes.title: Official Construction in Old Canal of Inba Marsh

episodes.synopsis: Atl's dissatisfaction with the Human world reaches its peak, and she summons a massive Yōi which falls under the Western Ones' control. To complicate matters, Yuki discovers that Genbatsu has joined the Western Ones.
episodes.title: Fantasy of the Latter Southern Dynasty

episodes.synopsis: To complete their master plan, the Western Ones use Atl's power to summon another gigantic Yōi deep into the Ayashi's lair, but Yuki and his companions bring forth the full power of their ayagami to stand against them.
episodes.title: Intermission
